main.summary: Tenant-scoped storage boundary for transfer staging, publication assembly, and cleanup.

method.name: DeleteTransferAsync
method.summary: Delete all staging artifacts for the transfer while preserving final published artifacts.
method.returns: True when staging artifacts are absent after the operation.

method.name: OpenObjectAsync
method.summary: Open the staged serialized object payload.
method.returns: Readable staged object stream, or null when it is unavailable.

method.name: OpenRangeAsync
method.summary: Open a staged logical transfer range.
method.returns: Readable staged range stream, or null when it is unavailable.

method.name: OpenChunkAsync
method.summary: Open a staged stream operation chunk.
method.returns: Readable staged chunk stream, or null when it is unavailable.

method.name: OpenPublicationObjectAsync
method.summary: Open the serialized publication object payload for a transfer operation.
method.returns: Readable publication object stream, or null when it is unavailable.

method.name: PublishObjectAsync
method.summary: Publish a staged object into the final item namespace using a server-side tenant-storage operation.
method.returns: Final object reference, or null when publication fails.

method.name: TryLoadPublishedObjectAsync
method.summary: Loads the final object artifact reference for this item instance when the artifact exists.
method.returns: Published object reference, or null when it is absent.

method.name: TryLoadPublishedStreamAsync
method.summary: Loads the final stream artifact reference for this item instance when the artifact exists.
method.returns: Published stream reference, or null when it is absent.

method.name: TryLoadPublishedIntegrityAsync
method.summary: Loads the final integrity artifact reference for this item instance when the artifact exists.
method.returns: Published integrity reference, or null when it is absent.

method.name: AssembleStreamAsync
method.summary: Assemble a final stream from a destination-ordered block plan within tenant storage.
method.returns: Final stream reference, or null when assembly fails.

method.name: SaveIntegrityAsync
method.summary: Write the final integrity artifact after content verification.
method.returns: Final integrity reference, or null when the write fails.

method.name: SaveObjectAsync
method.summary: Save the staged serialized object payload.
method.returns: Staged object reference, or null when the write is rejected.

method.name: ReplaceObjectAsync
method.summary: Replace the staged serialized object payload.
method.returns: Staged object reference, or null when the write fails.

method.name: SaveRangeAsync
method.summary: Save a logical segmented-transfer range under the transfer prefix without replacing an existing immutable Blob.
method.returns: Staged range reference, or null when the write is rejected.

method.name: SaveVerifiedRangeAsync
method.summary: Stream and save a logical segmented-transfer range while verifying its declared length and SHA-512 digest.
method.returns: Verified staged range reference, or null when validation or storage fails.

method.name: SaveVerifiedChunkAsync
method.summary: Stream and save a stream operation chunk while verifying its declared length and SHA-512 digest.
method.param: Logical range represented by the chunk.
method.returns: Verified staged chunk reference, or null when validation or storage fails.

method.name: SavePublicationObjectAsync
method.summary: Save the serialized publication object payload for a transfer operation.
method.returns: Publication object reference, or null when the write is rejected.
